articles.summary: The 2025 Formula 1 season is gearing up to be a thrilling spectacle with Lewis Hamilton making a historic switch to Ferrari, while six rookie drivers will grace the F1 grid, bringing fresh energy and fierce competition. McLaren stands firm as they aim to defend their recent Constructors' Championship title, while Red Bull seeks redemption after losing a key driver, Sergio Perez. Meanwhile, Sauber begins its transformation into Audi for 2026. Get ready for intense rivalries, groundbreaking rookie introductions, and major team reshuffles!
articles.title: F1 2025 Grid Shake-Up: New Faces and a Legend’s Bold Move
